newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Telenet awards contracts for 6.4 bln Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Telenet awards contracts for 6.4 bln Bfr.

text.p: Belgian telecommunications start-up Telenet Operaties NV, which aims to convert Flanders' extensive cable television network to provide multimedia and voice telephone services from late 1997, on Monday awarded its first contracts, the company said in a statement.
Telenet Operaties is a unit of Telenet Holding NV, which is 25 percent-owned by U.S. West International and 20 percent by the Flander's publicly-owned investment company GIMV.
Telenet said its digital telephone exchanges would be supplied by Telindus Nortel, a joint venture between Belgium's Telinfo and Canada's Northern Telecom.
Other equipment, cabling and modems will come from units of Alcatel, Siemens and Motorola.
In total, the contracts awarded on Monday total 6.4 billion Belgian francs out of a total planned investment of 37 billion Belgian francs, Telenet said. It did not provide details.
